scope: CEO Wave1: product pivot from point accuracy to calibrated exceedance. P(load > contracted C) from archived causal models' dev residuals, evaluated on the SAME frozen reserved targets. C = P75/P90 of train values (synthetic contract scenarios, honestly labeled). Climatology (train frequency) is the honest reference.
probability: Empirical residual CDF from dev rows (H3+H4 pooled per model, 672 residuals); P(y>C) = 1 - F(C - pred), clipped [0.005, 0.995].
metrics: Brier score vs outcome; reliability table (10 bins); alert cost curve over thresholds 0.1..0.9 with cost = 10*missed_event + 1*false_alarm (the 2x-tariff fine dominates, illustrative weights frozen here).
verdict_rule: EXCEEDANCE_EDGE requires some model's Brier < 0.95*climatology Brier on BOTH C levels. Otherwise NO_EDGE_OVER_CLIMATOLOGY. All descriptive/retrospective; no production claim.
limitations: Consumed data; synthetic contract levels; cost weights illustrative; residuals pooled across horizons H3/H4.
